single_variable: Cap the whole parent order across four underlying children to 10% of the median native quote turnover of the last 60 complete minutes. One-percent sensitivity. Missing or zero prior turnover gives no purchase; a cap below one millionth of a USDT rounds to zero. Keep the original phantom admission/seat until that signal exits even if its allocation is zero, so there is no use of later prices to select a replacement.
baseline: Replicate the fee-only unrestricted native 1570 parent fills, cash PnL, and every hourly mark to numerical tolerance with an infinite cap. Use the actual dynamic 1x/2x parent leverage and verify currency quantity, cap and cash separately. All initial 1000U, other exits, 20% trim mechanics and costs unchanged. Preserve +5bp market fill stress for 10% and 1% caps.
diagnostics: Measure subsequent first-minute realized participation only after the cap-constrained backtest. This volume is never an input to a trading decision. Unknown turnover and partial venue coverage remain visible. This is an entry capacity scenario. Depth at the first print, exiting impact, funding and contract rounding remain unmodeled.
